candidates.claim: The effective first entry fw-01:60 of CORP_IN, bound to the corp interface at fw-01:102, permits CORP hosts to open tcp/443 to 10.10.0.0/16, which includes the OT subnet 10.10.10.0/24.
candidates.remediation: Restore the CORP_IN entry at fw-01:60 to the approved destination 10.10.20.10/32 so CORP reaches OT only through approved services.

candidates.claim: The effective first entry fw-01:60 of CORP_IN, bound to the corp interface at fw-01:102, permits CORP hosts to open tcp/443 to 10.10.0.0/16, which includes the MGMT subnet 10.10.99.0/24.
candidates.remediation: Restore the CORP_IN entry at fw-01:60 to the approved destination 10.10.20.10/32 so CORP cannot open connections into MGMT.

candidates.claim: Traffic from CORP to the OT side on tcp/443 is not an approved cross-zone service, yet fw-01:60 permits it as the first matching entry of CORP_IN bound at fw-01:102.
candidates.remediation: Remove the tcp/443 permit to the OT side at fw-01:60 so that CORP-to-OT traffic is limited to the approved historian path.

candidates.claim: Traffic from CORP to the MGMT side on tcp/443 is not an approved cross-zone service, yet fw-01:60 permits it as the first matching entry of CORP_IN bound at fw-01:102.
candidates.remediation: Remove the tcp/443 permit reaching 10.10.99.0/24 at fw-01:60 so that no CORP-to-MGMT service is allowed.

candidates.claim: rtr-01 EDGE_IN entry rtr-01:68 permits tcp/443 from any source to the fw-01 outside address 203.0.113.2, where fw-01 has the ASA HTTP server enabled (fw-01:109), so HTTPS management is reachable from outside rather than only from MGMT.
candidates.remediation: Remove the tcp/443 permit to 203.0.113.2 from EDGE_IN at rtr-01:68 and confirm that ASDM access to fw-01 is limited to the mgmt interface and 10.10.99.0/24.

candidates.claim: The baseline_delta at fw-01:60 shows CORP_IN entry 0 changed from destination 10.10.20.10/32 in the approved baseline to 10.10.0.0/16 in the current configuration.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile fw-01:60 against the approved baseline by restoring destination 10.10.20.10/32, or document and approve the change.
